instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended down at your sides.
2. Curl the dumbbells up while dragging your elbows backward, keeping them close to your body.
3. Continue until the dumbbells reach the front of your shoulders.
4. Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position under control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows drifting back, not forward, to keep tension on the biceps.
2. Move slowly and avoid swinging or using momentum.
3. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your shoulders still throughout the movement.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
2. Bend your working arm to 90 degrees with your elbow pinned to your side and forearm pointing forward.
3. Rotate your forearm outward, keeping your elbow fixed against your body.
4. Pause when your forearm points out to the side.
5. Lower the forearm back to the starting position under control, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use a light weight and strict form.
2. Keep your elbow pinned to your side the whole time.
3. Keep your wrist straight and in line with your forearm.
4. Do not rotate your torso; move only at the shoulder.

instructions:
1. Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Bend your arms with elbows pointing out to the sides at shoulder height and palms facing the floor.
3. Press the dumbbells forward until your arms are fully extended.
4. Bring the dumbbells back to shoulder level under control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest and stomach against the bench to avoid arching your back.
2. Keep your wrists straight and in line with your forearms.
3. Use a light weight to keep the rear shoulders working.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades as you press.
